summary: The diff implements speech-to-text dictation in the scan confirmation step and persists an editable description into stored food entries (including backend state migration). It also adds an automatic Dashboard “Weekly Summary (Last 7 Days)” card with a 1–10 style visualization and deterministic, local rule-based feedback. One clear mismatch is that the weekly summary returns a score of 0 when there are zero entries, which violates the 1–10 score acceptance criteria.

missing_requirements.requirement: Weekly summary displays a numeric score from 1 to 10 (with an insufficient-data state when no entries exist).
missing_requirements.reason: For the empty-data case, the weekly summary generator returns score = 0, which is outside the required 1–10 range.
